review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The mutation replaces a conditional guard `if scope.actor_role not in policy.actor_roles:` with `if False:`, which permanently disables the actor role enforcement check. The original code would raise an exception or take a restrictive action when the actor's role is not in the permitted roles list; the mutated code never executes that branch regardless of the actor's role. This produces an observable behavioral difference: requests from actors whose roles are not in `policy.actor_roles` will no longer be blocked/rejected by this check and will instead proceed through the gateway as if they were authorized.
